description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to mill a card and return Grave-Shell Scarab from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing you to discard Grave-Shell Scarab.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
